features.name: Serialize Simple Object
features.description: Serializes one scalar object to a compact JSON string.

features.name: Deserialize Simple Object
features.description: Deserializes one compact JSON object and validates every scalar member.

features.name: Serialize Nested Object
features.description: Serializes an order, customer, and address object graph.

features.name: Deserialize Nested Object
features.description: Deserializes and materializes an order, customer, and address object graph.

features.name: Serialize Collection
features.description: Serializes three ordered objects to a compact JSON array.

features.name: Deserialize Collection
features.description: Deserializes a compact JSON array to three ordered objects.

features.name: Serialize Dictionary
features.description: Serializes three ordered string and integer entries to a JSON object.

features.name: Deserialize Dictionary
features.description: Deserializes a JSON object to three ordinal string and integer entries.

features.name: Enum Round Trip
features.description: Serializes an enum as its string name and deserializes it back.

features.name: Custom Converter Round Trip
features.description: Serializes a strongly typed identifier as a JSON string and deserializes it back.

features.name: Polymorphic Round Trip
features.description: Round-trips a base-type collection through safe cat and dog discriminators.

features.name: UTF-8 Stream Round Trip
features.description: Serializes a simple object to a new UTF-8 memory stream and deserializes it back.

features.name: Source Generation Round Trip
features.description: Round-trips a simple object with compile-time generated JSON metadata.

features.name: Prepare Serializer
features.description: Creates fresh serializer settings and explicit type metadata without serializing data.
